brief.claim: Across 90 farms, a farm that applies more fertilizer per hectare obtains a higher crop yield per hectare: the standardised regression slope (both variables z-scored) of yield per hectare on fertilizer per hectare is at least 0.3.

data_keys.meaning: total annual crop harvest of the farm, tonnes
total annual fertilizer applied on the farm, kg of nitrogen
cropped area of the farm, hectares
